description: Renovate only opens PRs; Mergify (.mergify.yml) merges them. Keep Renovate's own automerge off: with it on, Renovate merged #1017 two minutes after rebasing it, before CI had run on the new commit, and main broke on macOS and Windows.

packageRules.description: Update the tsrs toolchain together; each bump needs the dobesv/tsrs fork rebased and the [patch] rev updated
prBodyNotes: Rebase the dobesv/tsrs fork on this upstream revision and update the [patch] rev in Cargo.toml before merging.
